name: textarea
purpose: Collects multi-line free-form text from the user. Sibling of `input` in the `inputs` category; renders a fixed-size (`large`) multi-line field with a minimum height of 80px. The resize axis is controlled by the `resizable` prop (defaults to `vertical`). Native textarea attributes (`rows`, `maxlength`, `name`, etc.) flow through via attribute fallthrough.
useWhen: Capture multiple lines of free-form text (descriptions, comments, messages).
avoidWhen: The value is a single line → use `input`.
The value is strictly numeric → use `number-input`.
related: input` — single-line sibling with the same field API.
bestPractices: Give it a sensible default size; avoid auto-growing beyond the viewport.
Wrap it in a `Field` for the label, description and error.

Set `monospace` on a value that is code: a pasted zone file, a certificate, a JSON or YAML snippet, a list of IPs. Pair it with `:spellcheck="false"`. Prose (a description, a message) stays in the sans face.
A value people edit as code with highlighting and line numbers belongs in `CodeEditor`; `monospace` is for a plain paste box.
Do not restyle a read-only textarea (dashed border, transparent fill): it is the same filled field, made non-editable; the reason belongs in the field's description.

props.name: placeholder
props.doc: Placeholder shown when the field is empty.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Disables interaction and applies disabled tokens.

props.name: readonly
props.doc: Marks the field read-only: the value is visible, focusable and copyable but not editable. Keeps the filled field (surface and solid border) with no hover border and a default cursor (`data-readonly`), the same look as `Input`; distinct from the disabled field.

props.name: invalid
props.doc: Applies invalid styling and sets `aria-invalid`. Combined with `required`, switches to warning border tone.

props.name: required
props.doc: Marks the field as required and sets `aria-required`.

props.name: resizable
props.doc: Which axes the user can drag to resize the field. `none` locks the size; `vertical` keeps the default behavior.

props.name: monospace
props.doc: Sets the value and placeholder in the monospace code face (`.text-body-code-sm`, which wraps) for pasted zone files, certificates, JSON and lists of IPs (`data-monospace`). Same prop as on `Input`.

examples.name: Default
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Textarea from '@aziontech/webkit/textarea'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const value = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <Textarea
    v-model="value"
    placeholder="Write your message"
  />
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Textarea from '@aziontech/webkit/textarea'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const value = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <Textarea
    v-model="value"
    placeholder="Placeholder"
    disabled
  />

examples.name: Invalid
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Textarea from '@aziontech/webkit/textarea'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const value = ref('Text Filled')
</script>

<template>
  <Textarea
    v-model="value"
    aria-label="Description"
    invalid
  />
</template>
